Text_Clause: "Commodity transaction shall be performed daily on an approved trading platform."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Ensures the Tawarruq process involves real Shariah-compliant assets and actual trade.

Text_Clause: "The contract includes a condition that the customer must provide a loan to the bank."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Prohibited combination of a sale and a loan (Bay' wa Salaf).

Text_Clause: "The Bank will provide you with a copy of the PDS for your Baiti Home Financing."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant with transparency requirements under the Shariah Governance Framework.

Text_Clause: "This product finances the construction of a casino and hotel complex."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Funding of Gambling (Maysir) facilities is strictly prohibited.

Text_Clause: "Ibra’ calculation: (Settlement Amount - Outstanding Sale Price) + Accrued Profit."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Adheres to the standardized formula for Ibra' as regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia.

Text_Clause: "Price is based on the future unknown value of a speculative index."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Excessive Uncertainty (Gharar) in the determination of price.

Text_Clause: "Proceeds from the transaction will be disbursed for the purpose of refinancing."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant use of Tawarruq for debt restructuring or property refinancing.

Text_Clause: "The loan involves a pre-signed agreement to sell back the asset at a lower price."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Involves Bay' al-'Inah (buy-back sale) which is used to circumvent Usury rules.

Text_Clause: "You are required to take up a Mortgage Reducing Term Takaful (MRTT)."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Adheres to Shariah requirements by using Takaful for risk mitigation.

Text_Clause: "The bank will charge an additional fee for the 'time-value' of the money lent."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Explicit charging of Usury (Riba) for the passage of time.

Text_Clause: "The Ceiling Profit Rate acts as a cap to protect the customer from rate fluctuations."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant mechanism to ensure fairness and reduce Uncertainty (Gharar) for the customer.

Text_Clause: "Default in payment may result in your property being foreclosed by the Bank."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant as the bank has the right to collateral in a secured Murabahah transaction.

Text_Clause: "Investment is made in a fund that deals with conventional treasury bonds."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Investment in interest-bearing instruments involves Usury (Riba).

Text_Clause: "Gharamah (penalty) shall be distributed by the Bank to charitable organizations."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant with Shariah as the penalty does not contribute to the bank's profit.

Text_Clause: "The asset being sold does not exist and cannot be delivered."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Sale of non-existent assets involves Uncertainty (Gharar).

Text_Clause: "This PDS provides you with key information on your Wahdah Home Refinancing."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Promotes transparency and avoids Uncertainty (Gharar) regarding product terms.

Text_Clause: "The contract includes hidden charges not disclosed during the signing."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Presence of Uncertainty (Gharar) and lack of transparency in pricing.

Text_Clause: "Total Profit is based on the Ceiling Profit Rate of 10.25% p.a."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant as the total profit is capped and agreed upon at the start of the contract.

Text_Clause: "The loan balance will be reduced by a lottery draw held once a year."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Incorporates elements of Gambling (Maysir) in debt settlement.

Text_Clause: "The Bank's BRI or SBRI may change by giving at least 21 calendar days notice."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant with regulatory notice periods to ensure transparency for the customer.

Text_Clause: "Penalty interest will be charged if the property is not insured by a conventional insurer."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Compelling the use of interest-based insurance and charging Usury (Riba).

Text_Clause: "Hibah of the Takaful benefits can be made to your named nominees."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant use of Hibah (gift) for the distribution of Takaful benefits.

Text_Clause: "The selling price is indexed to the price of gold in a separate future contract."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Complex contracting leading to Uncertainty (Gharar) and potential speculation.

Text_Clause: "The customer shall pay the Bank the Sale Price through monthly installments."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant deferred payment structure (Bai' Bithaman Ajil) in Islamic financing.

Text_Clause: "The loan is subject to an annual fee for maintaining the 'interest-free' status."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Fees that scale with loan size or duration are often disguised Usury (Riba).

Text_Clause: "The Bank shall inform you of any revisions to the monthly payment amount."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Ensures transparency, helping the customer avoid Uncertainty (Gharar).

Text_Clause: "Transaction involves investment in pork meat producing companies."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Investment in Haraam industries violates Shariah Ethical Screening.

Text_Clause: "The Bank may exercise its right to set-off any credit balance in your account."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant administrative right for debt recovery under the Shariah Governance Framework.

Text_Clause: "The agreement is signed without the buyer knowing the total cost of the asset."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Excessive Uncertainty (Gharar) regarding the price.

Text_Clause: "Effective Profit Rate is lower than or equal to the Ceiling Profit Rate."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant adjustment mechanism ensuring the customer benefits from Ibra'.

Text_Clause: "The lender takes a commission for every year the principal remains unpaid."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Periodic commissions on principal are a form of Usury (Riba).

Text_Clause: "The Bank will provide you with a Product Disclosure Sheet (PDS)."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant with BNM standards for consumer protection and transparency.

Text_Clause: "The bank takes zero risk and guarantees profit even if the asset is destroyed."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Non-Compliant: Violates the Risk-Sharing principle where profit is tied to liability.

Text_Clause: "The contract follows the Shariah concept of Musyarakah Mutanaqisah."
Shariah_Justification (Academic Standard: Compliant via a Diminishing Partnership model for property financing.
